description_expanded:
Beachfront on Seagrove Beach!

Gorgeous deck leads directly to beach

Private pool

4 bedrooms, 4 baths

4 bikes.

Family Ties by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Beachfront! And a private pool?! Believe! Welcome to Family Ties, a 30A jackpot with gulf views, salty breezes, and a front-row seat to the waves. This Old Seagrove retreat puts you right on the sand, with Seaside’s charming shops and restaurants just a breezy bike ride away.

Explore Seaside and Seagrove! 🚿 Outdoor shower 🍤 Gas grill 🦞 Great dining! 🛍️ Shops, boutiques, eateries The sunroom and outdoor lounge are made for unwinding, whether it’s morning coffee with a view or dinner with a backdrop that steals the show. The kitchen, dining, and living areas serve up more of those stunning Gulf views, along with plenty of space to relax. Just off the living room, two bedrooms feature more incredible views. A guest room with two twin beds, and a gorgeous primary suite. Down the hall, a cozy sitting room, with a pull-out sleeper sofa and a bathroom, leads out to the spacious pool area. There’s also another guest room, with 2 twins, and lastly, a second, plush primary bedroom. Enjoy! At Oversee 30A, we do vacation right. A spotless home, a seamless stay, and a local team always nearby. Our office is just down the road, open daily, with 24/7 support whenever you need us. Have a large family? Consider booking "Ethridge House" at 67 Montgomery Street as well! Reserving both houses guarantees exclusive access to the private beach, only thirty steps away. Overview: - Beachfront - Private pool - 4 bedrooms, 4 baths - 2008 sq ft - Propane grill - Wi-Fi - 4 bikes included - Parking is limited to 4 vehicles - Outdoor shower has hot and cold water - No on-street parking Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath, TV - Guest Room: 2 twins, TV - Pull-out sofa in sitting room, private bath, TV - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath, TV - Guest Room: 2 twins, shared hall bath, TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
